# Legacy grain native characterizations

Frozen before grain translation at `09643ce`, using the accepted Rust
profile/development sampler. The manifest shares fields and synthetic results
whose decoded words and row order match. Each OS keeps its own product results,
which its Debug and Release presets share. The manifest records active file
digests and original capture digests. Floating values are raw words and
identities are exact. Ordinary tests use these checked-in payloads.

Each preset’s selected values contain 36 complete route products, 758
resolved-control cases and 144 explicitly labeled metadata-helper cases. The
shared synthetic payload contains 28 genuine completed Developments, including
finite sampled values whose normalization overflows.

The archived OFX recordings contain 198 amount/chroma/policy/preset cases and
36 edit/fallback/master/reset/time cases through the actual getters. The
manifest’s `archived_ofx` section maps each original preset to its recording
and exact digest in the [tagged grain fixtures](https://github.com/oldandangry/Film-Juicer/tree/archive/spectral-cutover-2026-11/tests/film/grain-fixtures).
Original commands, executable/module/resource identities, failed attempts and
raw traces remain in the referenced capture campaigns.

Metadata helper cases include unsupported native polarity; the safe typed constructor has no unsupported polarity. Nonfinite helper values do not claim complete-profile admission. The six testing-OFF status/failure expectations are the reviewed literal ABI contract, not returned Rust values. Native capture owns amount/chroma/default conversion until S6.B/C.
